title: Choose the visual world for kalunchan.dev
question: The roll assigned the Bell System Practices manual. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Engineering Practice Manual
options.lineage: Bell System Practices, the numbered carrier-network standards KC's career started in (COVAD, Talkfree VoIP)
options.thesis: The portfolio as a leader's own practice manual: numbered sections, issue stamps, and schematic signal-flow drawings. It refuses the hero → cards → CTA template.
options.viewport: A title block that fills the first screen. At left, set very large: 'I build teams, systems, and products that deliver.' At right, a schematic draws the seven capabilities as one signal path from business problem to shipped outcome. Issue and revision stamp at the top edge; LinkedIn contact sits in the title block.
options.risk: Can tip into cosplay if section numbers and stamps outnumber the content. The numbering has to carry navigation, not decoration.

raised.raise: Traceability: every outcome on the page links back to the decision that produced it.
Blue fields are reserved for one 'what matters now' region per page, never scattered as accents.
The career is one unbroken ruled line from 1998 to now, with a marker showing where 'now' is.
Key decisions show every option considered as a ghosted row, with the chosen one struck forward.
A persistent section coordinate is locked to one corner, so you always know where you are in the manual.
Every section leads with one plain claim so clear the detail can stay quiet.

options.label: Architecture Decision Record
options.thesis: Every page is a decision record with a status stamp and its consequences.
options.viewport: An ADR-style header: status Accepted, then the one-line thesis as the Decision.
options.risk: Familiar: this is where most engineer-portfolio redesigns land.

options.label: Jacquard punched brocade
options.case: Fuses poorly: hiring executives don't recognise themselves in a loom.
options.kept: Traceability from outcome down to each individual decision.

options.label: Glazier color-field partition
options.case: Clear one-statement panes, but no link to the engineering world.
options.kept: Colour reserved for what matters now; hierarchy by field size.

options.label: Drum machine step row
options.case: Playful, and wrong in register for executive hiring.
options.kept: One unbroken line with a live 'now' marker.

options.label: Cathode numeral gauze
options.case: Near-black with a glow is the portfolio cliché the brief bans.
options.kept: Alternatives shown as ghosts, with the chosen one struck forward.

options.label: Broadcast signal degradation
options.kept: A persistent coordinate locked to a corner.

options.label: Fletcher wit poster
options.case: Wit reads as unserious for VP-level evaluation.
options.kept: One idea per section, stated so plainly the craft can relax.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The polished leader portfolio: big name, role line, logo row, case-study cards.
canonCard.viewport: Name and title hero, a logos strip, then three case-study cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other leader portfolio by design.
